fixture_repair: SpringCaveTest now attaches its mining controller to the SceneTree before calling the mining filter. The first run was stopped after detecting the detached-node error; all nine cave seeds pass after repair.
benchmark_weather: Both final fresh-world comparisons explicitly select rain before settling. Saved runs restore clear weather from the same copied save. All phases record weather.
final_measurements: loop_control_fresh, loop_control_saved, loop_optimized_fresh, loop_optimized_saved; all use --no-ablations so both active pan phases run with uninterrupted simulation.
candidate_selection: An additional per-step notification cache offered only a small controlled gain and mixed native results. The final version keeps the simpler lookup and allocation reductions. Exploratory runs, including slower frame results, are retained separately.
functional_execution: The sixteen final-source fixtures ran in three isolated headless groups after native measurements. Their durations are not performance measurements. The final differential comparison ran separately.
measurement_scope: Sequential native real-time runs, no concurrent tests/builds; eight seconds per phase in evolving worlds. Editor executable in standalone mode. Exported-package correctness and release startup verified separately.
